name: Rot and Regret
summary: Woodwyrd asks you to quench the flame that burdens an ancient spirit at the Forlorn Gardens. The spirit points you toward sacred water in Maraudon.

sections.title: A Spirit's Burden
sections.body: The ancient spirit says its final mistake binds it to this place, where it still feels a flame in death. It asks you to seek pristine water from a sacred ravine across Mashan’she. Maraudon is the place named, and Woodwyrd awaits the Vial of Earth Song Water at the Forlorn Gardens.

faq.q: Who is asking for the water?
faq.answer: Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens asks you to bring back a Vial of Earth Song Water for the ancient spirit.

faq.q: Why does the ancient spirit want the flame put out?
faq.answer: The spirit says it is burdened by its last mistake and still feels the flame in death.

faq.q: Where can I find the sacred water?
faq.answer: The spirit points you to Maraudon, across Mashan’she, for pristine water from a sacred ravine.
Woodwyrd asks you to bring back a Vial of Earth Song Water.
